messages.author: 71879c31fafddeee
messages.subject: Multi-group Analysis from Correlation Matrices
parts:
Hi, 

Is it possible to use individual correlation matrices for each group in a multi-group analysis in Lavaan? I am looking to do an analysis of some historical data for which only the correlation matrices are available.

Best

Tom

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Multi-group Analysis from Correlation Matrices
parts:
On 05/04/2013 10:32 PM, TOM BOOTH wrote:
> Hi,
>
> Is it possible to use individual correlation matrices for each group in
> a multi-group analysis in Lavaan? I am looking to do an analysis of some
> historical data for which only the correlation matrices are available.

lavaan (0.5-12) does not support the analysis of correlation matrices
(yet). At least not out of the box.

If you have covariance matrices per group (say cov1, cov2, ...), you can
provide them as a list via the sample.cov argument:

fit <- sem(myModel, sample.cov=list(cov1, cov2, ...), sample.nobs=c(200,
400, ...), ...)

Yves.

Hi Tom,

You may try the metaSEM package (http://courses.nus.edu.sg/course/psycwlm/Internet/metaSEM/). It allows the analysis of correlation matrices with either a fixed-effects or a random-effects model.

Mike
